title: Garden Makeover Match
description: Clear layered garden tile stacks in classic triple-match style to earn renovation stars and turn an overgrown estate into a blooming paradise.
controls: Tap uncovered tiles to place them into the tray; match three identical icons to clear them and earn garden stars.

zh-CN.title: 花园装修家
zh-CN.description: 爆款三消叠加装修玩法花园装修家：在层叠牌堆中收集三个相同图案消除攒星，亲手打造鸟语花香的私家大花园！
zh-CN.controls: 点击未被遮挡的卡牌放入下方槽位，凑齐三张相同图案消除赢星星装扮花园。
